app.name: Haq
app.tagline: Find the insurance your family is owed

landing.title: Find the insurance your family is owed
landing.subtitle: No policy document needed. Photograph your bank passbook to find covers, check eligibility, and get claim forms.
landing.step1_desc: Haq treats your passbook entries as the policy document. No physical certificate needed.
landing.step2_desc: Evaluates PMJJBY, PMSBY, and RuPay rules, eligibility criteria, and lookback periods.
landing.step3_desc: Download ready bilingual claim forms, deadline alerts, and bank escalation letters.
landing.trust_free_desc: No commission, no middlemen. Built for poor families, Bank Mitras, and CSP centers.
landing.trust_privacy_desc: Uploaded photos are deleted right after reading. Aadhaar numbers are masked to last 4 digits.
landing.trust_rules_desc: Strict government rules decide eligibility, not arbitrary AI predictions.
landing.claim_desc: If an account holder passed away or suffered an accident, find their cover.
landing.protect_desc: Check if your insurance is active and avoid losing your cover.
landing.resume_desc: Enter your 6-letter case code and 4-digit PIN to open your saved case.

PMJJBY.name: PMJJBY life cover
PMJJBY.explanation: ₹2 lakh if the account holder dies for any reason. Premium ₹436 a year, auto-debited.

PMSBY.name: PMSBY accident cover
PMSBY.explanation: ₹2 lakh for accidental death or total disability. Premium ₹20 a year, auto-debited.

RUPAY_PMJDY.name: RuPay card accident cover
RUPAY_PMJDY.explanation: Up to ₹2 lakh for accidental death, if the RuPay card was used in the 90 days before.
